details.limitations: Monitored sites may not represent all residents. Site participation and reporting vary by week; comparisons are affected by coverage. Not an infection probability.

details.transformation: Deduplicate sample/target by latest update. Sunday–Saturday sample weeks; any positive makes a site positive. Unknown detection flags excluded. Clade, assay and site coverage can vary.
details.limitations: No detection means no positive in the connected tests, not absence of disease. Different sampling frequency changes detection opportunity. H5 may originate from animals. Not population weighted.
